title: Sankalp_IP HRMS v1.2.3 Pro Edition
description: Department Broadcast Notifications, Live Attendance Clock with Seconds, 09:30 AM Cutoff Timing, Fixed Corporate Salary Standard, Resilient Password Reset, and Cyber-Neon Dark Mode.
releaseNotes: Resilient Password Reset with fallback resolving 500 error when mail server is offline
Department-wide broadcast notifications and individual employee target selections
Live Attendance timestamp with date, time, and seconds (HH:MM:SS AM/PM)
Automatic attendance rule: <= 09:30 AM Present, > 09:30 AM Late, with 24-hr cycle lock
Removed check-out/outing time to streamline daily attendance check-in
Bulletproof SVG animated Donut and Attendance status distribution meters on mobile and PC
Fixed standard corporate base salaries mapped across all 11 departments
Character-by-character real-time search filtering across all tables
Interactive slidebars under tables for seamless mobile and desktop scrolling
Cyber-neon dark theme polish with high-contrast readable typography and glowing accents
